title: Lime Berry Orange Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
description:
Lime Berry Orange Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
Fresh, Zesty Flavor in Every Puff
Dive into a vibrant citrus medley with the Lime Berry Orange Geek Bar Pulse X 25000. Each puff bursts with the tangy zest of lime, the luscious sweetness of ripe berries, and the refreshing kick of juicy orange. This perfectly blended trio delivers a taste experience that’s both invigorating and satisfying, making it the ultimate choice for flavor enthusiasts.
Convenience Without Compromise
Designed for on-the-go vapers, the Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 is your perfect companion. This disposable vape offers an effortless experience with zero maintenance required. Simply unwrap it, take a puff, and enjoy smooth, flavorful clouds with every use. No refills, no fuss, just pure convenience and taste at your fingertips.
Long-Lasting Enjoyment
With up to 25,000 puffs, the Pulse X 25000 ensures you can savor its bold, fruity flavor for far longer than conventional disposables. Whether you’re tackling your daily grind or relaxing with friends, this vape will stay by your side, delivering consistently rich and satisfying hits.
Sleek, Pocket-Friendly Design
The Lime Berry Orange Geek Bar not only tastes exceptional but also looks sleek and modern. Its compact and lightweight design easily fits into your pocket, purse, or bag, making it the ideal vape for those who value both style and practicality.
Key Features
Puff Count
:
Up to 25,000 (Regular Mode) or 15,000 (Pulse Mode)
E-liquid
:
18mL, 5% nicotine
Battery
:
820mAh rechargeable (USB-C)
Display
:
Smart 3D Curved LED Screen
Coils
:
Dual Mesh for superior flavor
Modes
:
Soft, Normal, Pulse
Airflow
:
Adjustable for customized draw
Elevate your vaping experience with the Lime Berry Orange Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 and enjoy bold flavor meets effortless convenience.
